overall_structure.value: Hot-torsion deformed Fe–8% Al ferritic alloy in which continuous dynamic recrystallization (CDRX) operates. The original large grains are progressively elongated along the shear direction and subdivided by subgrain boundaries. Subgrain boundaries progressively transform into grain boundaries with increasing strain, so the initial large-grain microstructure is progressively replaced by a much finer 'recrystallized' one and the volume fraction of grain boundaries strongly increases. Fragmentation is selective (some grains more fragmented than others). At intermediate strain the material is an 'aggregate of crystallites' bounded partly by low angle boundaries (LABs) and partly by high angle boundaries (HABs).
